text:
Asha M: Quick sync — we need a tight set of battlecard soundbites for next week's webinar + an inbound routing snippet for SDRs. Focus: clear wins vs CloudX and LLMAPI, and a routing heuristic for noisy eval leads. draft: <https://docs.redwood.internal/marketing/bench-handoff|bench-handoff doc> :spiral_calendar:
Miguel G: skimmed — love the direction. can we add a one-line econ stat comparing per-token unit cost on a 1k-token chat? customers want numbers up front. :money_with_wings:
Taryn R: we ran benchmark 03 on staging yesterday — median p99 latency is comparable to CloudX at <=512 tokens and cost is ~45% lower at our default batching. will paste numbers.
Taryn R: ``benchmarks/03-summary.csv -> p50: 110ms, p95: 260ms, p99: 420ms; cost-per-1k-tokens: CloudX $0.18 vs Redwood $0.10``
Jules C: perfect — I'll craft 3 short bullets per competitor: (1) claim, (2) proof point, (3) one-liner kill phrase for SDRs. Example for infra vendors: "You can build, but you still pay for unpredictability — Redwood gives predictable cost + rollbacks." :sparkles:
Samir P: pls add the product hooks: dedicated + private + routing fallback. Sales needs the SLA numbers and how to answer "why not just run on-prem?"
Ellie S: for SDRs: need 2 quick rebuttals: pricing + reliability. Suggest: "If predictability matters, our Reserved flow reduces unit cost variance by X and has SLA-backed latency" and "We auto-fallback to compatible model variant to avoid outages." Keep <15s speak time.
Asha M: added rebut lines and a one-paragraph webinar opener. shortened to 4 soundbites: "Cost predictability", "Production-grade latency", "Unified API across hosting modes", "Ops-ready rollouts". Can we vote on top 2 hooks? :thumbsup: / :rocket:
Miguel G: :thumbsup: Cost predictability + Ops-ready rollouts
Jules C: :rocket: Latency + Unified API (devs care about friction)
Ellie S: both combos work for different personas — recommend routing by intent.
Asha M: routing draft (SDR playbook block):
Asha M: ```
# inbound routing pseudo-config
- if question contains [pricing, cost, unit, tokens] -> route: pricing-sdr
- if mention contains [sla, latency, p99, p95] -> route: eng-advocate + enterprise-sdr
- if mentions [private, vpc, on-prem] -> route: security-ps + solutions
- if tokens_estimate > 5000 or LLMAPI_competitor_mentioned -> route: AE-enterprise
```
Samir P: make sure the enterprise path includes "demo with Dedicated" checkbox + SLA doc link. add internal tag `needs-bench-sheet` so AE has proof.
Asha M: done. updated doc and short copy in the repo. pinging LaunchBot to create a versioned copy and notify sales channel.
LaunchBot: Created versioned copy at <https://docs.redwood.internal/marketing/bench-handoff/v2|bench-handoff v2> and posted summary to #sales. :robot_face:
Miguel G: awesome — can Jules turn the competitor bullets into 2 tweet-length lines each? we need social + webinar slides.
Jules C: on it. will drop first draft by EOD and tag design for slide snips.
Asha M: thanks team — final ask: please add one customer quote (anonymized) if you have it. I'll stitch into the webinar opener. meeting 11:30 tomorrow to finalize slides. :calendar:
Ellie S: I have a quote from Acme that fits — will DM it to you. :white_check_mark:
Taryn R: I'll attach the raw CSV and perf graphs to the doc after the meeting.
Asha M: perfect. short and actionable — love it. closing thread.
